sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished high-quality unique CLEAN BACKGROUND PLATE for portrait4:5 jigsaw puzzle illustration "Five butterflies visiting a rich garden of flowering plants". Premium cozy travel-game storybook digital painting matching approved Art Direction V2 gameplay art: tactile subtly brushed surfaces, fine hand-painted detail, believable dimensional objects, gentle upper-left sunlight, rich color separation and small discoveries. NOT flat vector, NOT photorealistic, NOT generic procedural art. A close rich flower garden dominated by large coral-pink zinnias, cosmos and blossoms, varied natural green leaves and some pale background. NO BUTTERFLIES OR INSECTS anywhere in this clean background: exactly five separately painted butterflies will be composed later. Leave five naturally open air pockets among flowers. Detailed realistic flower structure, softly painted rich coral color. Viewpoint: close cozy three-quarter view. The picture must fill the entire portrait4:5 canvas, ideal1280x1600; no borders, text, UI, grid, title, logo, watermark or transparent holes. This is a complete naturally composed environment with real stable anchors for five small moving details later added as separate alpha layers. Do not add floating decorative particles or overlay patterns. Preserve coherent scale and perspective. No famous destination landmark. Keep the requested main color visible throughout the scene, not only a tiny accent.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production RGBA transparent sprite atlas of five unique painted details belonging to the scene "Five butterflies visiting a rich garden of flowering plants". Match a premium cozy illustrated puzzle: rich dimensional storybook digital painting, subtle brushed pigment, believable natural forms, fine detail, soft upper-left sun, coherent warm light and tactile materials. No flat vector, no photos, no generic geometric particles. EXACTLY five isolated objects, strict3 columns by2 rows, landscape3:2 canvas. Leave the sixth bottom-right cell perfectly empty transparent. TRUE alpha transparency, no matte, no background, no grid or cell borders, no frame, no shadow rectangle, no labels or text. Place each entire object inside the central50% of its own cell, leaving wide25% gutters on every side. FULL complete loops, stems, wings, wisps and thin strands must fit safely inside each cell; none may touch canvas or cell edges. Top row left to right: a bright blue butterfly with dark wing edges, wings open and slightly angled, detailed natural veins; a golden-orange butterfly with warm brown markings and scalloped wing edges, side view half-open wings; a creamy white butterfly with delicate dark wing-tip marks, viewed from above. Bottom row left to right: a soft lavender butterfly with pale silver wing accents, asymmetrical three-quarter pose; a russet and ivory butterfly with small warm amber spots, wings open diagonally; EMPTY. Preserve detailed painted alpha edges and translucent material where specified. Do not include containers, scenery or extra items. All five details are real meaningful parts of this specific scene, sharing its scale and light.
